capabilities.citation: No device-side identification without a credential; operator records only

session_limits.citation: S22 Table 7.63 (SER holds up to 1,024 rows); Table 7.5 note a (Port 1: two Telnet sessions, the platform takes one); p. 7.33 (a wrong password re-prompts, the third pulses SALARM, so one attempt); p. 7.16 and Table 4.104 sheet 2 (state stays until TIDLE, 1 to 30 min, expires: the platform assumes 30 and waits 31). min_interval_ms is a platform choice, not a device fact (Phase 0 register proposal).
